summary: User swapped LINK to USDC then saw wallet balance drop to zero and contacted a Telegram account posing as Sushi support. The impersonator claimed funds were stuck due to zero slippage and instructed the user to repeat the transaction to release funds.
user_mistake: contacted fake support via Telegram and considered repeating the transaction
prevention: close the Telegram chat and use only the official Sushi support channel inside the app / do not repeat any transaction to unlock funds
